label: above ground level
definition: A reference level at the local ground surface, from which heights are measured vertically.
comment: Abbreviated AGL. It is the standard reference for anemometer heights and turbine hub heights in wind studies.

label: above sea level
definition: A reference level at mean sea level, from which heights and elevations are measured vertically.
comment: Abbreviated ASL or AMSL. It is used for terrain elevation and for heights given relative to a common vertical datum.

label: above hilltop level
definition: A reference level at the top of a hill, from which heights are measured vertically.
comment: It is used in studies of wind over hills, where the speed-up over the crest is described relative to the hilltop rather than to the surrounding ground.
